Without regular refactoring or restructuring, outdated patterns, poor architecture, and duplicated logic persist. As the system grows, the cost of fixing debt increases, leading to inefficiencies, bugs, and reduced agility. SUSTAINING SUCH DEBT BECOMES MORE EXPENSIVE OVER TIME.

Overgrazing may cause plant species to decline, favoring more tolerant or invasive species. This shifts plant communities toward more resilient but less diverse types.
